requirementSummary: When a Cooling Package is entered, the system must populate the Cooling Circuits, calculate the DX Coil Height as the sum of all Circuit Height values, display this sum in the DX Coil Information section, and automatically update the DX Coil Height whenever any Circuit Height is edited.
businessRules: When a Cooling Package (e.g., "R-454B FW 43") is entered, the system runs calculations to obtain starting values.
After the package entry, the list of Cooling Circuits must be populated.
The DX Coil Height field is calculated as the sum of the Height values of all populated Cooling Circuits.
The calculated sum is displayed in the DX Coil Information section.
If a user modifies the Height of any Cooling Circuit, the system must recompute the sum of all circuit heights and update the DX Coil Height field in DX Coil Information accordingly.
developerConsiderations: Implement event handling so that any change to a Circuit Height triggers a recomputation of the DX Coil Height.
Ensure the aggregation logic correctly sums all current Circuit Height values, regardless of how many circuits are present.
Update the DX Coil Height display in the DX Coil Information section immediately after each recalculation.
ambiguities: What unit of measurement should be used for Circuit Height and DX Coil Height (e.g., inches, meters)?
How should the system behave if there are zero Cooling Circuits (e.g., should DX Coil Height remain empty or be zero)?
Are there any rounding rules or precision requirements for the summed height (e.g., number of decimal places)?
Should the calculation be triggered immediately upon entering the Cooling Package, or only after the Cooling Circuits are fully populated?
How should invalid or non-numeric Circuit Height inputs be handled?
